{{Quote|This is General Wedge Antilles and the New Republic unit Rogue Squadron calling the Leresen task force. You're encroaching without permission on Bothan space. Please state your intentions.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
'''Bothan Space''', also known as the '''Bothan sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Bothan Space included [[Mandell]], [[Sennatt]], [[Torolis/Legends|Torolis]], [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Krant]], and [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]].

==Description==
Bothan Space included some 150 settled [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], most of them dominated by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colonists, and was ruled by the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]], made up of representatives from hundreds of [[Clan|Bothan clans]].<ref name="TEA" />

The edge of Bothan Space was known as the [[Bothan Border]].<ref name="TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|By the way, General Tur-Mukan is operating around the Bothan sector, and appears to be coping, according to Commander Gett. And she's still packing the conc rifle, so your lesson wasn't wasted.|[[Ordo Skirata]]|<ref name="TZ" />}}
The Bothan Space joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sometime between [[17,000 BBY]] and [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Space had a status of [[Allied Region]] that allowed it to conserve some independence from the Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

In [[11,198 BBY]], the region was victim of the [[Twenty-Third Pius Dea Crusade]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Sometime prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the entire sector was saved from [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] bandits by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Knol Ven'nari]].<ref name="SWR 53">[[Republic 53|''Republic'' 53]]</ref> During the Clone Wars, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] was operating around the Bothan sector.<ref name="TZ" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] allowed Bothan Space to retain its Allied Region status, as an [[Imperial client state]], but kept a wary eye on the Bothans and their ambitions.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> the sector was [[Noolian Crisis|invaded]]<ref name="TPS" /> by the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> until its liberation by the Empire.<ref name="TPS" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Bothan Sector Force]] was active in the sector during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> By the time of the early Galactic Civil War, passengers to flights at [[Spaceport THX1138]] that had Bothan Space as the destination required that the passengers show their [[Imperial authorization form]] before boarding.<ref name="TAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

The sector was represented by [[Polo Se'lab]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]; by [[Borsk Fey'lya]] on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]]; and by [[Mak Sezala]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Bothan_sector.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The location of Bothan Space in the galaxy according to Timeline 5.]]
In ''[[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui]]'', the map indicates Bothan Space in the "northeast quadrant" of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] while all other sources, including ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicate it is in the "southeast quadrant."
